question: Return the full names of users who live in properties that they own.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "users" AS SELECT "user_id" AS "user_id", "first_name" AS "first_name", "middle_name" AS "middle_name", "last_name" AS "last_name", "user_address_id" AS "user_address_id" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "properties" AS SELECT "property_id" AS "property_id", "owner_user_id" AS "owner_user_id", "property_address_id" AS "property_address_id" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "addresses" AS SELECT "address_id" AS "address_id", "line_1_number_building" AS "line_1_number_building", "line_2_number_street" AS "line_2_number_street", "line_3_area_locality" AS "line_3_area_locality", "town_city" AS "town_city", "zip_postcode" AS "zip_postcode", "county_state_province" AS "county_state_province", "country" AS "country" FROM table_3;
S:
# Create a small result listing full names of users whose residence address matches an address of a property they own.
result_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  u.first_name,
  u.middle_name,
  u.last_name
FROM users u
JOIN properties p
  ON p.owner_user_id = u.user_id
JOIN addresses a_user
  ON a_user.address_id = u.user_address_id
JOIN addresses a_prop
  ON a_prop.address_id = p.property_address_id
WHERE u.user_address_id = p.property_address_id
ORDER BY u.last_name, u.first_name, u.middle_name
""")
